title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the variance in model accuracy by conducting random experiments where the correct answer is inserted into a random order of candidate options for each test example.

Analyzing the model's error and correct predictions by correlating them with historical item popularity degrees, dividing items into popular and non-popular groups to observe if popular items are disproportionately recommended.
